title: Incarnated
tagline: A character memory protocol for eternal beings on Ethereum.
description: Incarnated helps game developers, storytellers and world builders create characters with persistent identities anchored to ENS subdomains (`elara.incarnated.eth`) and rich personality data stored on Walrus. Summon them into any world, game, or conversation, they remember who they are, who they've met, and what they've lived through.
how_its_made: Built on Scaffold-ETH 2 with Privy for wallets. Characters live as ENSv2 subnames (*.incarnated.eth) while Walrus stores profile, memories, and relationship graphs. Our Solidity registry keeps only pointers; integrators pull via pullByLabels then fetch Walrus. Together AI generates beings and experiences; GSAP drives the cinematic landing; Three.js powers summon orbs. Generations are indexed on Walrus with a localStorage pointer.
auto_summary: A Scaffold-ETH app for creating ENS-linked character identities with onchain registry pointers and Walrus-backed profile and memory data.
